description: One record per product category (产品品类). Distinct from Task Category (category.schema.json): this is the product/service under study, not the user's task domain. Source: PDT v1.3.1 §6.9.

name.description: One-line product category name, e.g. 智能营养秤

parent_id.description: Optional parent category; must not form a cycle

product_category_id.description: Globally unique product category number, e.g. PCAT-001. IDs are never reused.

status.description: Only confirmed categories may be referenced by a published study scope

version.description: Definition change bumps the minor version; a merge or split bumps the major version and leaves a rename mapping

title: Product Category Entry
